verdict.rationale: Gusto's Embedded Payroll docs explicitly describe running regular/off-cycle payroll for employees and a full contractor payment API (direct deposit, check, payment groups, submission blockers) side by side, plus platform-overview text listing both employee payroll and 'Manage contractor payments' as core capabilities — clearly a single-platform payroll for both worker types. Community comments corroborate general payroll quality, though one comment (gusto-comm-3) notes confusion about contractor-only setups, which is a different scenario than mixed W-2+1099 payroll and doesn't contradict this story. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of running a single payroll cycle containing both W-2 and 1099 payees simultaneously.
